reviews.title: Bring back user controls/options
reviews.text:
I just purchased the yearly subscription for Lensa about a 1-2 weeks ago after having evaluated a few other similar alternatives. Now there's been a major version released just last week that's changed or removed quite a few features/options/etc.

Per the two sentences in the release notes, the changes are intended to make the app more "user-friendly" and "streamlined" but I'm not entirely sold on the direction the developers are headed with this update to say the least. Feels like the app has been dumbed down significantly to make it more user-friendly for even the most tech illiterate users out there. I'm not against making the app more accessible but these changes went too far in terms of sacrificing functionality/settings/user control—trying to edit photos with this update currently feels awkward & slightly frustrating.

The devs really need to take a hard look at what's made this app great (400k+ reviews wasn't for nothin') and find a balance between improving usability & maintaining the more advanced functionality/options for experienced users.
